name: ladle

definition.en: a large deep spoon with a long handle for serving soup
definition.tr: çorba servis etmek için uzun saplı, derin büyük kaşık
definition.de: ein großer tiefer Löffel mit langem Stiel zum Ausschöpfen von Suppe
definition.fr: une grande cuillère profonde à long manche pour servir la soupe
definition.it: un grande cucchiaio profondo con manico lungo per servire la minestra
definition.es: una cuchara grande y honda de mango largo para servir sopa

origin: Old English hlædel, from hladan (to load, to draw water)
